title: Xdrip + Android Wear (Sony Smartwatch 3)
body: Hello! Where can I get Xdrip + version for android that works with Android Wear. In the last version that I have now, it is not supported. Want to use it with Sony Smartwatch 3. Thanks in advance for your help.

comments.body:
Which version of xDrip did you install? Please post just the version information, no screenshot.

You should find the "Android Wear Integration" in the "Smart Watch Features" settings.
@Dusikus Is your question answered? If yes, please close this issue.

@Dusikus Please use the support channels for asking questions.
